title: P2TPO: Structure-Aligned Page-to-Token Credit Assignment for Full-Page Document Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2610.21979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end full-page document parsing must preserve the content and structure of heterogeneous elements, yet otherwise accurate outputs can contain local errors and omissions. A single page-level advantage does not explicitly identify which elements differ in quality across sampled outputs or where their errors occur. We introduce Page-to-Token Policy Optimization (P2TPO), a structure-aligned credit-assignment framework that operates on full-page policy trajectories. Reference-element alignment first associates block-level quality contrasts with generated spans. Unified Anchor Pricing (UAP) incorporates matched and missing element outcomes and provides feedback relative to a fixed quality ceiling when sampled outputs receive identical but imperfect scores for a reference element. Within matched blocks, Span Credit Redistribution (SCR) redistributes existing block credit according to aligned correct and erroneous spans, using boundary p

translated_title: P2TPO：面向整页文档解析的结构对齐页级到词元级信用分配
translated_abstract: 端到端的整页文档解析必须保留异构元素的内容与结构，然而即使输出总体准确，其中仍可能包含局部错误与遗漏。单一的页级优势无法明确指出在采样的多个输出中，哪些元素的质量存在差异，以及错误发生在何处。我们提出了页级到词元级策略优化（Page-to-Token Policy Optimization, P2TPO），这是一个作用于整页策略轨迹的结构对齐信用分配框架。参考元素对齐首先将块级质量对比与生成的文本片段关联起来。统一锚点定价（Unified Anchor Pricing, UAP）综合了匹配与缺失元素的结果，并在采样的输出对某个参考元素获得相同但不完美评分时，提供相对于固定质量上限的反馈。在匹配的块内，片段信用重分配（Span Credit Redistribution, SCR）根据对齐后的正确与错误片段重新分配已有的块级信用，利用边界p……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: P2TPO提出了一种结构对齐的信用分配框架，通过参考元素对齐、统一锚点定价与片段信用重分配，将页级奖励细化到词元级别，从而提升端到端整页文档解析的准确性与完整性。
en_tdlr: P2TPO introduces a structure-aligned credit-assignment framework that refines page-level rewards down to the token level via reference-element alignment, unified anchor pricing, and span credit redistribution, improving the accuracy of end-to-end full-page document parsing.
